name: browsercontrol
description: Browser work + VISUAL VERIFICATION, including screenshotting AUTH-GATED / LOGGED-IN pages (Gmail, the GuildOS app, any account the operator is signed into in their MAIN Chrome). Take a screenshot via a Playwright browser logged into the operator's accounts — the way a headless leaf visually verifies a page behind a login. Local Claude uses Claude-in-Chrome MCP; cloud agents use their VM's native Playwright; headless quest LEAVES (which cannot use CIC) drive/screenshot via the leafBrowser weapon — Playwright running system Chrome on the operator's logged-in profile.
author: GuildOS
